LanguageData.RC_Text_22c742356ee3ce9b: Executor, our vanguard has reached the planet surface.
LanguageData.RC_Text_af15c253af7e128c: We need to suppress at least four subnodes to obtain intelligence on the Romulus hub node.
LanguageData.RC_Text_c5206243b8f5bc11: To end the Legion threat once and for all, we must suppress every subnode. Our allies can protect the reality stabilization anchors we install.
LanguageData.RC_Text_f31e857e7baa1e75: The relevant intelligence is displayed on your terminal. Xiya out.
